What is the difference between kVA and kW?

kVA is apparent power, kW is active power. They are linked by the power factor: kW = kVA × PF. Modern UPS have PF = 1, i.e. 20 kVA = 20 kW. Loads usually have PF 0.8–0.95, so an 18 kW load at PF 0.9 needs 20 kVA.
